historicalPr.title: Adjust dashboard window comparison
historicalPr.body: Operators compare neighboring sensor windows. A sample exactly at the shared end must appear in both panels; the overlap is intentional. Make the end inclusive.

discussion.body: Confirmed after the dashboard check: keep the end inclusive so the shared boundary sample remains visible in both adjacent windows. This is the reason we accepted the change.

reviewPr.title: Simplify window end comparison
reviewPr.body: Tidy the comparison used by sensor window grouping.

proposedOracle.expectedFinding: Changing <= to < removes the shared endpoint from the earlier of two neighboring dashboard windows, contrary to the recorded decision in merged PR #7. Cite the exact changed line and verify the historical decision against the current code.
